content.text:
Silhouette: Four-legged brown bear frame. Host frame: the brown bear sets the outline, body size and overall frame. A single creature that combines a european rhinoceros beetle and a brown bear. Head of the brown bear, fully visible and uncluttered, with clear, discernible eyes. Details: brown bear body and legs, with its own dense fur on the face, plain coat, no stripes or spots; from the european rhinoceros beetle, as parts and materials on the brown bear's own body: a head horn grown from the frontal bone of the head, above and between the eyes, out of the covering, which continues from there into the body covering: smooth, glossy dark cuticle, with one long curved head horn curving upward and back from the head; hard, glossy chitin plates with fine seams in its own colors, grown from the skin as the brown bear's own covering over the crown of the head, neck, shoulders, back, flanks, belly, hips, legs and tail: it replaces the brown bear's dense fur there and conforms to the brown bear's body, a few large, smooth, fused plates, each spanning a whole body region of the brown bear (the shoulders, the back, the hips, each limb section), sized to the brown bear's body, joined by flexible cuticle at every joint; every covered part keeps the brown bear's own length and shape, and the tail stays the brown bear's own tail; the dense fur stops at the covering's edge, and the face keeps the brown bear's own dense fur. The covering follows the body's own shape and bends at every joint. Declared fiction: arthropod parts at large size, shown with thick supporting legs and rows of small breathing openings (spiracles) along the flanks. Bilaterally symmetrical, recognizable limbs, visible sense organs. Habitat cue (forest): dark back and light belly (mild countershading). Prosaic detail: natural lighting, feet in firm contact with the ground with a soft shadow, normal wear on hooves, claws and skin. One creature, full body, side three-quarter view, plain light background, natural history illustration.
Aspect ratio: 1:1.

summary.text:
**Designing hybrid creature silhouette**
I'm planning the image around a four-legged brown bear outline, keeping the head fully visible with clear eyes and dense fur, then adding the beetle's curved frontal horn and glossy chitin plates over the crown, neck, shoulders, and back.
**Planning arthropod bear illustration**
I'm organizing the bear's armored plates, jointed limbs, spiracles, and forest countershading into a natural-history illustration plan, and I'm looking up a European rhinoceros beetle for accurate arthropod details.
**Generating natural history illustration**
I'm producing a 1:1 natural history illustration of the hybrid bear, showing a side three-quarter view with brown fur, a frontal horn, glossy chitin plates, spiracles, and dark-back light-belly countershading on a plain light background.
**Refining segmented armor design**
I'm adjusting the illustration to integrate the armor more naturally, reduce the separation between segments, and keep the spiracles subtle while preserving the black horn.
